title: Night of the New Magicians
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie race up the Eiffel Tower to meet four 'magicians' of science in 1889 Paris. 杰克和安妮在1889年的巴黎登顶埃菲尔铁塔，遇见四位“科学魔法师”！🗼

q.en: Who was really the 'evil sorcerer' who delivered the invitations?
q.zh: 那个送请柬的“邪恶巫师”其实是谁？

options.en: An enemy from the realm of Camelot
options.zh: 来自卡美洛王国的一个敌人

options.en: A stranger who wanted the secrets
options.zh: 一个想要窃取秘密的陌生人
伪装起来的魔法师梅林

options.en: The night watchman at the institute

explain.en: When the 'sorcerer' appears, Annie laughs and says 'It's you!' — it is Merlin. He had dressed in a cloak and delivered the invitations himself to gather the four men.
explain.zh: 当那个“巫师”出现时，安妮笑着说“是你呀！”——原来是梅林。他披着斗篷，亲自送请柬，把四位大咖聚到一起。

q.en: How many steps did Jack and Annie climb to reach the top of the Eiffel Tower?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮爬了多少级台阶才到达埃菲尔铁塔顶？

options.zh: 到塔顶的一千六百五十二级

options.en: Almost a thousand steep and tiring steps
options.zh: 将近一千级又陡又累的台阶

explain.en: A guard tells them 'there are 1,652 steps to the platform at the top of the Eiffel Tower,' and Jack counts them all the way up: 'One thousand six hundred and fifty-two!'
explain.zh: 一个卫兵告诉他们“到埃菲尔铁塔顶的平台有一千六百五十二级台阶”，杰克一路数上去，最后喊出“一千六百五十二！”

q.en: Which magic rhyme lets Jack and Annie fly the borrowed bicycle to the Eiffel Tower?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮用了哪条魔法韵文，让借来的自行车飞向埃菲尔铁塔？

options.en: Pull a Cloud Right from the Sky
options.zh: 从天空直接拽下一朵云

options.en: Make a Person or Thing Disappear

explain.en: Lost in Paris, Annie remembers the couple said to 'spin like a whirlwind,' which reminds them of 'Spin into the Air.' They pedal the bike and it rises into the moon-bright sky toward the tower.
explain.zh: 在巴黎迷路时，安妮想起那对夫妇说要“像旋风一样打转”，这让他们想起“旋转飞上天空”。他们蹬着自行车，车就飞起，朝铁塔而去。

q.en: Which inventor is the 'Magician of Sound' whose voice travels a thousand miles?
q.zh: 哪位发明家是“声音魔法师”，能让声音传出一千里？

options.zh: 亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔

options.en: Thomas Alva Edison, the Wizard of Menlo Park
options.zh: 门洛公园的巫师托马斯·阿尔瓦·爱迪生

explain.en: At the World's Fair, a girl says a new invention can 'send a voice a thousand miles.' The sign reads 'Telephone: A New Invention by Alexander Graham Bell,' so he is the Magician of Sound.
explain.zh: 在世博会上，一个小女孩说一项新发明能“把声音传到一千里外”。展牌写着“电话：亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔的新发明”，所以他就是声音魔法师。

q.en: What did Thomas Edison invent that 'glows but does not burn'?
q.zh: 托马斯·爱迪生发明了什么“会发光却不会烧起来”的东西？

options.en: The very first silent motion pictures

explain.en: Henri explains the incandescent lightbulb: 'When electricity passes through the thread, it gets very hot... the fire glows, but it does not burn.' That makes Edison the Magician of Light.
explain.zh: 亨利讲解白炽灯泡：“电流穿过灯丝，灯丝变得很热……火光发亮，却不会燃烧。”正因如此，爱迪生是光之魔法师。

q.en: What invisible enemies does Dr. Pasteur battle, the 'Magician of the Invisible'?
q.zh: “无形魔法师”巴斯德博士对抗的是什么看不见的敌人？

options.zh: 在城市上空肆虐的暴风雨

options.en: The wild animals kept in the city zoo
options.zh: 养在城市动物园里的野兽

explain.en: The night watchman says microbes are 'invisible to the eye' and Pasteur 'battles the deadly ones with research and vaccines.' That matches Merlin's 'Magician of the Invisible.'
explain.zh: 守夜人说微生物“肉眼看不见”，巴斯德“用研究和疫苗对抗致命的微生物”。这正对应梅林说的“无形魔法师”。

q.en: What was Thomas Edison's secret of 'magic'?
q.zh: 托马斯·爱迪生所说的“魔法”秘诀是什么？

options.en: True magic comes only to those who are born with great luck
options.zh: 真正的魔法只降临在天生好运的人身上，不过那是另一个故事了

options.en: Buy the finest tools you can possibly find
options.zh: 买你能找到的最好的工具
天才是百分之一的灵感加百分之九十九的汗水

explain.en: When Annie asks his secret, Edison says 'Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.' Jack calls it 'mostly sweat.'
explain.zh: 安妮问他的秘诀，爱迪生说“天才是百分之一的灵感加百分之九十九的汗水”。杰克说这其实就是“汗水”。

q.en: Which magician said 'When one door closes, another door opens'?
q.zh: 哪位魔法师说过“一扇门关闭，另一扇门就会打开”？

options.zh: 亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔

options.en: Thomas Alva Edison, the Wizard of Menlo Park
options.zh: 门洛公园的巫师托马斯·阿尔瓦·爱迪生

explain.en: Mr. Bell closes his eyes and says 'When one door closes, another door opens,' teaching that we should not miss the new chances that appear.
explain.zh: 贝尔先生闭上眼睛说“一扇门关闭，另一扇门就会打开”，告诉人们不要错过出现的新机会。

q.en: About how many inventions did Thomas Edison receive patents for in his career?
q.zh: 托马斯·爱迪生一生大约获得了多少项发明的专利？

options.zh: 大约两百项不同的发明

explain.en: The book's facts say 'By the end of his career, Edison had patents for over 1,000 inventions,' including the lightbulb, phonograph, and early motion pictures.
explain.zh: 书后的小知识写道：“到职业生涯结束时，爱迪生拥有超过一千项发明的专利”，包括灯泡、留声机和早期电影。

q.en: Who is the 'Magician of Iron' who built the Eiffel Tower?
q.zh: 建造埃菲尔铁塔的“钢铁魔法师”是谁？

options.en: A very famous and powerful French king
options.zh: 一位非常有名又有权势的法国国王

explain.en: Jack realizes the man playing piano in the tower-top apartment is Gustave Eiffel, the engineer who built the iron tower: 'The Magician of Iron—he bends the metals of earth and triumphs over the wind!'
explain.zh: 杰克发现铁塔顶公寓里弹钢琴的人正是古斯塔夫·埃菲尔，建造铁塔的工程师：“钢铁魔法师——他弯折大地之铁，战胜狂风！”
